name: Bain & Company
one_liner: MBB firm known for results-focused consulting, market-leading private equity work, and a famously supportive, team-oriented culture.
at_a_glance: Roughly 20,000+ employees across ~65+ offices in ~40 countries.
Market-leading private equity practice (due diligence and portfolio work).
Repeatedly #1 on Glassdoor's Best Places to Work list; $1B pro bono commitment.

rounds: Screen: some offices use an online test (formats vary by office).
First round: ~2 case interviews, each with fit questions.
Final round: ~2-3 case interviews with senior leaders, sometimes including a behavioral-focused interview.
interview_process.case_style: Candidate-led: clarify the question, lay out a structure, drive the analysis, and adjust to interviewer cues. Practical business judgment and clear math matter more than one 'right' answer.
interview_process.fit_style: Behavioral questions in most interviews; Bain wants to know why you want Bain specifically and how you work in teams. Same questions per role to reduce bias.
interview_process.assessments: No universal test; some offices use an online screening test (e.g., aptitude or case-style questions). Check your invitation.

what_they_look_for: Intellectual curiosity and love of problem solving
Clear, genuine motivation for Bain specifically
culture: 'A Bain-er never lets another Bain-er fail' captures the team-support ethos.
Strong social culture and office community; frequent Glassdoor #1 ranking.
Emphasis on results, not reports: recommendations clients actually implement.
why_us_angles: How does Bain's results-focused, implementation mindset compare with how things got done at your last employer?
Is private equity exposure (fast diligence work) a draw, and why?
What have Bain people you met said about the supportive culture, and why does that matter to you?
How does Bain's pro bono or social impact work connect to your values?
prep_tips: Practice Bain's public cases (e.g., Coffee Shop Co., FashionCo.) and watch its mock interview videos.
Lead the case: summarize, structure out loud, and state next steps without waiting to be asked.
Prepare a sharp, specific 'Why Bain' story backed by conversations with Bain people.
Practice quick PE-style cases: market attractiveness, competitive position, and deal recommendation.
Ask your recruiter whether your office uses an online test and practice that format.
